sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's energy transition hinges on PLN's capex cycle and feed-in tariff revisions, making policy clarity the dominant swing factor for local renewables valuations.
US solar demand is structurally supported by IRA subsidies and grid-scale backlog, insulating SEDG/ENPH from near-term rate volatility.
Climate-tech capital is bifurcating: US equipment makers benefit from reshoring incentives, while Indonesian developers face currency and offtake risks that cap upside.
sectors.ai: US-listed renewables rebounded on rate-cut hopes while Indonesian names lagged on rupiah weakness and policy uncertainty. Buy US solar equipment (SEDG, ENPH) for near-term beta, but rotate into Indonesian utilities (HGII) only after clarity on PLN procurement and tariff reform. Hedge IDR exposure via NRG-style cash-flow names.

sectors.name: Property & Real Estate
themes: Jakarta's revised 2040 spatial plan is unlocking land-bank revaluation for developers with strategic plots in eastern and northern corridors, a multi-year catalyst independent of macro swings.
Falling BI rates are compressing cap rates on income-producing assets, directly lifting net asset values for REIT-like developers (MSIE, MTLA) and sustaining dividend yields above 6%.
The IDX property index's persistent discount to replacement cost, now at a 12-year low, sets up mean-reverting M&A and privatization flows from cash-rich conglomerates seeking cheap urban land.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-yield, land-bank-rich developers (GRIA, HBAT) as rate-cut expectations and Jakarta's new spatial plan re-rate asset values; trim US-exposed names (ASPI, IPAC) on dollar strength. Buy pullbacks in NIRO and MTLA for dividend resilience, and avoid POLI until its debt refinancing closes.
